answers.9: Red — results matter more to Reds than rules.

answers.12: Yellow — least organized, but has a huge network and always knows who to ask.

answers.14: Yellow — expressive, image-conscious and wants to stand out.
answers.15: Red — thrives on challenges, competition and winning.
answers.16: Red — makes quick, snap judgments and firm first impressions.
answers.17: All four together — a balanced Red + Yellow + Green + Blue team covers every strength.
answers.18: Yellow — the talker of the four profiles.
